title: Goat-Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
description: These stuffed mushrooms make great bite-size appetizers.
ingredients: 2 packages (10 ounces each) crimini mushrooms, stems removed
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a rimmed baking sheet.
In a food processor, pulse bread and garlic until fine crumbs form. To food processor, add cheese, parsley, and red-pepper flakes. Season with salt, and pulse filling until combined.
Spoon filling into each mushroom; drizzle w/ olive oil. Place on prepared baking sheet; bake until mushrooms are tender and lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.
